### 🛡️ NotificationVault — Local Notification History & Archive for iOS

Never lose a deleted or dismissed notification again! NotificationVault seamlessly hooks into SpringBoard's notification dispatcher and securely archives every notification to a high-performance local SQLite database.

#### ✨ Key Features
- 📥 **Local SQLite Archive:** Records notification timestamp, bundle identifier, app name, title, body, and time-sensitive status.
- 📱 **Standalone Home Screen App:** Dedicated native app (`NotificationVault.app`) with instant search, filtering, card layout, and quick copy to clipboard.
- ⏰ **Lock Screen & DND Bypass:** Intercepts notifications even while your iPhone is locked or in Do Not Disturb mode.
- 🟢 **Simulation Suite:** Test real-time banner simulations for WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, and Time-Sensitive alerts.
- 🌐 **11-Language Global Support:** Native localizations across English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Japanese, Russian, Chinese, Arabic, and Vietnamese.
- 🛡️ **Zero Privacy Leaks:** All notification data is stored strictly locally at `/var/mobile/Library/NotificationVault/vault.db` and never leaves your device.
- ⚡ **100% Free Community Release:** Open-source and free for everyone.

#### 📱 Compatibility
- **Jailbreak:** Dopamine 2 (Rootless, `/var/jb`)
- **Firmware:** iOS 14.0 – 15.8.x – 16.x
- **Architecture:** `iphoneos-arm64` (A10–A16 devices)

#### Version 1.0.0
- Initial official public release on Doguner Repo!
- Low-level SpringBoard hooks for `NCNotificationDispatcher` & `BBServer`.
- Standalone native Home Screen application (`NotificationVault.app`) with search, filter, and swipe-to-delete.
- Native Settings integration with simulation testing suite (WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Time-Sensitive).
- Complete 11-language internationalization (EN, TR, DE, FR, ES, IT, JA, RU, ZH, AR, VI).
- Zero-lag SQLite write queue with WAL journal mode.
